summary: Adds a Cloud staging-delivery skill and makes EnterpriseGlue status, shipping, and release watchers distinguish publication from actual staging and production state.

instructions: Reinstall enterpriseglue-dev-workflows 0.1.9 from the repository marketplace and start a new Codex task so the updated skills are loaded.

security: The staging workflow remains read-only unless the user explicitly requests a mutation, excludes the retired EE repository, and requires the protected receipt-bound Cloud workflow for tenant movement or release retirement.
documentation: Updates the versioned Codex workflow plugin guide and the status, ship, post-ship, publication, and staging-delivery skills.
knownLimitations: Reinstalling the plugin does not alter an already-running Codex task; open a new task to load the new skill version.
rollback: Reinstall plugin version 0.1.8 to restore the previous skill set; this does not change repository or Cloud deployment state.
validation: The repository plugin contract tests, official Codex skill validator, official plugin validator, release-note checks, and documentation boundary guard pass locally.
